text:
mike: saw a weird pattern this morning - small jobs being ejected from dedicated pools, then routing back to hosted and spiking egress. logs attached. :eyes:

sara: ugh. timeline?

mike: 2026-03-18 07:12 - 07:18 UTC. cluster scheduler ejected 6 slices from eu-west-dedicated-1

kai: do you have the scheduler debug log snippet?

mike: pasted:
```
[I 07:12:05 scheduler] preemptive_eject: slice_id=eu1-slice-98 reason=egress_shaping_violation
[I 07:12:06 network] egress_policer: burst=1200kbps -> hard_drop
[I 07:12:07 allocator] route:fallback -> hosted-gen-2
```

tess: what's the policy? dedicated pools should not be ejected for egress unless they exceed tenant quota. maybe a misapplied egress-class tag. :thinking_face:

mike: looks like the new mini-scheduler change (PR #8421) added a fallback that treats egress bursts as cpu-style overload. probably misaligned with network shaping rules.

sara: can infra-bot pull the allocation history for those tenant IDs?

infra-bot: pulled 4 allocations for eu-west-dedicated-1 in window 07:05-07:20 UTC:
- tenant:metrics-ops (t-128) alloc_id a-789 (2m)
- tenant:image-gen (t-443) alloc_id b-002 (1m)
- tenant:noise-test (t-999) alloc_id c-111 (30s)
Link: https://telemetry.internal/alloc/a-789 (redacted)

kai: metrics-ops had a short-lived gRPC fanout -> concurrent egress spike ~1.1MB/s for 18s per pod. eviction triggered by egress-shield rule because edge-proxy returned repeated 503s and qdisc hit the hard cap.

mike: quick mitigation: set egress_class=non-blocking for dedicated pools in eu-west and rollback PR #8421. low-risk rollback scheduled now.

tess: cost question — repeatedly routing to hosted increases per-token and infra costs. Rough back-of-envelope: +$1.2k/day if this pattern repeats across a few tenants. we should treat this as a cost incident too.

sara: can we add a soft-quarantine for small noisy tenants instead of ejecting entire slice? maybe slice-level token cap + grace window.

kai: agree. propose short-term runbook: 1) revert fallback behavior; 2) soft-quarantine tenant (rate-limit egress per-alloc); 3) add egress burst window smoothing in proxy (5s moving average).

mike: I'll open an incident runbook and schedule hotfix. tagging @oncall.

sara: thanks. also add an alert: "dedicated-egress-eject-rate > 3 in 10m" :alarm_clock:

infra-bot: created issue INF-6421 and paged #oncall. Runbook draft: https://confluence.internal/INF-6421 (internal)

tess: rolling a hotfix now in eu-west-prod (canary 10% -> 50%). monitoring for 15m :rocket:

mike: thx. follow-up: retro to discuss long-term fixes: kernel offload, pcie egress shaping, and better tagging of egress_class at allocation time.

sara: assign me to INF-6421 for cost/rollout ops. I'll own communication with finance.

kai: piggyback note: check KVM guests with older qdisc settings; we saw a similar pattern in apac last year when qdiscs defaulted to fq_codel vs cake.

mike: update in 15m with telemetry snapshot link: https://telemetry.internal/graphs/alloc/521234 (will paste after canary)

sara: :thumbsup:
